title: Danish Gambit
blurb: Give two pawns for a fast attack with both bishops.
summary: 1.e4 e5 2.d4 exd4 3.c3: offer pawns for development; Bc4 and Bxb2 aim both bishops at the king.

children.note: Both bishops point at the king. Develop fast and attack.

Take. After ...Qxd5, cxd4 gives you a fine centre.
The Danish. Offer a pawn for fast development.
